spectral_multiplication_entry: G_t(a,b)=exp(-t(a-b)^2/4) Theta(t,(a+b)/2) up to common positive normalization; this is not the translated-source Weil Gram entry
rank_two_equivalence: for positive Theta, every rank-two Gram minor is nonnegative iff Q_t is convex, locally iff partial_xi^2 log Theta+2t>=0
heat_coordinate: tau=1/(4t); if U_tau=U_xixi and F=log U, q=F_xixi+1/(2tau)
first_contact: at a first zero spatial minimum, q_xi=0, q_xixi>=0, hence q_tau>=0; curvature positivity propagates forward in tau only
acceptance_test: First derive the translated-source character-weighted centered-Gaussian Gram interface with fixed Fourier constants; then prove its finite matrices PSD. The midpoint curvature inequality remains a separate spectral-multiplication test.
